description: Computes a payment system's management-information pack from declared AGGREGATE counts only (no transaction-level records, no personal data): a fixed KPI set covering speed (share of transactions credited within one hour and within one business day), average cost in basis points of transaction value, failure rate, availability from scheduled versus unplanned-downtime minutes, fraud value and count shares, complaint resolution within SLA, adoption (users per 1000 eligible population and accepting locations count), and transparency (share of services disclosing cost and speed). Each KPI carries its definition source in definition_ref: the speed percentage is compared against the pinned 75-percent-within-one-hour cross-border retail speed target on the g20_retail and fast_payment_scheme profiles; the cost, access and transparency KPI families are adapted from the pinned FSB retail KPI definitions; availability is anchored to the pinned operational-risk principle with the 99.9-percent reference level declared as a design convention; the remaining KPIs are declared design conventions. Missing-input KPIs are null with a reason code, never zero; channel totals that do not reconcile, credited counts above the declared total and negative declared values raise data-quality flags; a prior period of the same shape yields per-KPI deltas. Profile-keyed (generic, g20_retail, fast_payment_scheme, gov_payments). Declared scope limit: this node produces KPIs, not verdicts, it does not reconcile individual records and does not audit statements (the reconciliation and audit nodes art-516 and art-517 do that), and it never presents real scheme figures: every figure is computed from caller-declared aggregates.
